issue_context.title: [libraries] Skipping passing WASM tests
issue_context.body:
When running WASM library tests, a significant amount of [tests](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/files/4794289/tnse2.txt)
 were failing due to threading not being supported. As such, #37822 was created and merged to skip these tests in order to get WASM tests running on helix #37752. 

However, it was noticed that some tests being skip actually pass on master now (e.g. Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.Tests), so there is a need to rerun WASM tests to get a fresh list of test names that fail with `WASM: System.PlatformNotSupportedException : Cannot start threads on this runtime` or `WASM: System.PlatformNotSupportedException : Cannot wait on monitors on this runtime`. In doing so, the changes that skip passing tests on master can be reverted.
comments:
Tagging subscribers to this area: @safern, @viktorhofer

From commit hash  [fbf84d6911b](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/commit/fbf84d6911bf26f1bdf32a5071d50b449927f210), reran WASM tests before #37822 had been merged by following steps from [here](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/master/docs/workflow/testing/libraries/testing-wasm.md)

The test output obtained: [wasm_test_output_original.txt.zip](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/files/4799135/wasm_test_output_original.txt.zip)
After cleaning the test output, ran a script to obtain tests failing with `Cannot wait on monitors on this runtime.` and `Cannot wait on monitors on this runtime.` to obtain threading related test failures, narrowing down the failing tests to 221 tests: 
[Test names](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/files/4804713/20200619_wasm_test_names_us.txt)


Ran script to insert `[Conditional<Fact/Theory>(typeof(PlatformDetection), nameof(PlatformDetection.IsThreadingSupported))]` in source files to obtain the proper source file changes.

Reverted #37822, applied the first commit to add `IsThreadingSupported` and applied the proper source file changes to get #38089
